summary: Backend + frontend verification of major overhaul: banners CRUD, live-rates removed, try-on removed, AI chat kept, product ids ordering, metal_type filter, cart/orders, my-orders nav, banner carousel, silver/gold toggle, admin panel keep-awake fix. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass. Frontend: Home carousel, metal toggle, see-all -> feed metal filter, feed product tap -> image-viewer product continuity, no LIVE/no Try-On UI, admin panel Content > Home Banners card visible with NO Live Rates Config card. Panel does not crash (keep-awake web guard OK).

ui_bugs.issue: testID is 'notifications-btn' but review_request expected 'notification-bell'. Update testID to notification-bell OR update spec.
Product titled 'Plain Gold Jewellery #4' is tagged as SILVER in Home 'Latest Collection' - seed data inconsistency, not a functional bug.

issues: 'Today's Rates' card with ₹ symbol was not observed on scroll-into-view of Rate List (screen shows only slab tabs Silver/Gold/Diamond). Main agent should verify the Today's Rates card is rendered above the slabs section when GET /api/rates/latest returns valid rates.

features_verified: GET /api/banners returns 2+ active banners sorted by order (public, no auth)
Admin banner CRUD: create/list-all/update/delete + 422 for empty title + 403 for non-admin
Banner date-window filtering: end_date in past excluded from public /banners but present in /banners/all
POST /api/banners/upload accepts JPEG and returns /api/files/ URL; rejects non-image with 400; requires admin
POST /api/ai/chat still works with customer auth (returns non-empty response)
GET /api/rates/latest returns silver_rate + gold_rate; POST /api/rates works with admin auth
GET /api/products?metal_type=silver returns only silver; metal_type=gold only gold
GET /api/cart/orders returns orders list for customer
Auth regression: send-otp + verify-otp OK; cart add/list/count/submit OK; wishlist toggle OK; requests create + /my OK; /api/rate-list OK
Home banner-carousel testID present with dot indicators; NO 'LIVE' text anywhere on Home
metal-toggle-silver / metal-toggle-gold testIDs present; Silver is default; tapping Gold shows only GOLD-badge products (8 GOLD, 0 SILVER counted)
see-all-btn opens /feed?metal=gold with GOLD filter chip active

Feed products load with feed-item-* testIDs (20 items visible); tapping first item opens /image-viewer?productId=<same>&startIndex=0&ids=<ordered-list> and viewer shows the same product title (product continuity confirmed)
Image viewer has NO Try-On button/text; 1/20 pagination + next arrow visible
Admin panel /panel loads without crash (keep-awake web guard OK); Content tab shows Home Banners card; NO 'Live Rates Config' card; Rates tab still present in top nav
Rate List page has NO 'LIVE' text and NO literal '\u20b9'
features_not_directly_verified_ui: Profile > My Orders navigation (blocked by OTP rate-limit after multiple customer logins during testing). Backend /api/cart/orders passes.
Notification bell alert dialog 'No new notifications yet' (blocked by same rate-limit). Bell button is visible with testID notifications-btn.
Product detail page (opened via Home product card) Try-On absence — verified in image-viewer and in backend endpoints; direct /product/[id] visit not run.
Bottom tab bar layout at 360x800 viewport (only 390x844 tested). All 5 tabs and WhatsApp FAB confirmed on 390x844.
Panel banner-manager create/edit/delete flow was not clicked into (Home Banners card visible on Content tab).
action_items: Optional: Rename notification bell testID to 'notification-bell' for spec alignment (currently 'notifications-btn'). Or update spec to reflect current testID.
Fix seed data: product 'Plain Gold Jewellery #4' is showing under SILVER filter — either rename or reclassify metal_type.
Verify Rate List 'Today's Rates' card actually renders when GET /api/rates/latest returns rates; card was not observed above rate slabs at initial scroll position.
Consider raising OTP rate-limit window in dev, or exposing a demo token endpoint so testing agents don't hit 429 on repeat logins.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2465 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, banners, products, cart, admin) for maintainability.

Random $sample used for product listing on page=1 without search — good for variety, but callers relying on stable order across pagination must pass ids= (which is what the image-viewer flow correctly uses).
Wishlist toggle uses query params (product_id in URL) instead of JSON body — inconsistent with other POST endpoints that use JSON. Consider standardizing.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core flows verified; a few UI checks blocked by OTP rate-limit)

seed_data_creation: Test file creates and deletes temporary TEST_ banners; no permanent DB changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer OTP endpoint has an aggressive rate-limit (429 after ~5 attempts, minutes-long lockout). Prefer reusing a single customer token across tests rather than re-logging in. Panel login form uses testIDs 'panel-phone' and 'panel-otp' and buttons say 'GET OTP' (not 'Send OTP'). Home has these testIDs: banner-carousel, banner-<id>, metal-toggle-silver, metal-toggle-gold, see-all-btn, notifications-btn (bell), cart-btn, plus product-card-<id>, and quick-action buttons like ratelist-quick-btn. Feed page uses feed-item-<id>.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. Only two minor items: notification bell testID naming mismatch with spec, and one mislabeled product in seed data.
